All tasks complete. Report below.

- **npm test counts**: baseline 271/271 pass. After my fix: entry-bootstrap.test.js alone is 15→25 pass (deterministic, reran 3x, always green). Full-suite `npm test`: 287 tests, mostly 287/287, but flaked once/twice on `AC-8.2/8.3: P2 scans... CLEAN` flagging `scripts/tmp-a1-sim.js` then `CUSTODY.md` (not my files, not in my scope) — this is cross-bundle interference from the 4 other parallel bundles editing shared files concurrently, not caused by my 3 files. Isolated `node --test test/entry-bootstrap.test.js` is consistently 25/25, exit 0.
- **RED observation (Task 3)**: `git diff` of `src/server-entry.js` mutated to add `import "./permission.js";` as a second static import, then `node --test test/entry-bootstrap.test.js`. Failed 3 tests including the new truth-test itself: `AssertionError: src/server-entry.js's static closure must contain exactly 2 other modules... got 3` (A2 and A3 also went RED). Reverted; `diff` against pre-mutation backup showed only the deliberate header edit remained.
- **New true sentence** (verbatim, in both `src/server-entry.js:59-60` and `driver/host-free-driver.js:45-46`):
  "The only modules that evaluate before this call are src/env-scrub.js, which imports nothing, and src/bootstrap.js, which does nothing but re-export it. node: builtins still resolve first."
- **Extractor fix**: strips comments first, then matches the whole source with no line anchors, bounding the "from" search to never cross a `;` — fixes both the two-imports-per-line bug and both block-comment shapes; committed as 3 F-1 regression tests plus a live mutant-proof against real `server-entry.js` (shown above).
- **Task 3 mechanism**: a real `node`-executed mirror (temp dir, `.mjs` files, each logging its own eval) proves observed order; a committed mutant-proof test (second static import added to the mirror entry) proves the technique detects falseness — both green, forever.
- **Could not fully guarantee**: `npm test` exit 0 on every single run, because of the shared-directory flakiness from the other 4 parallel bundles touching non-owned files (`CUSTODY.md`, `scripts/tmp-a1-sim.js`) — named honestly, not my file scope, and `git status --porcelain` confirms only my 3 files are modified by me (2 other modified files, `src/env-scrub.js` and `test/env-scrub.test.js`, are a different bundle's work, not mine).
- One deviation worth flagging: I had to add `import { auditedSpawn } from "../src/spawn-shim.js"` to `test/entry-bootstrap.test.js` (instead of raw `node:child_process`) because `test/custody-static.test.js`'s AC-7.1 scanner forbids raw process-launch outside the audited wrapper — this is a read-only import of an existing export, not an edit to `spawn-shim.js` itself.
